    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SpringBoot使用TraceId日志链路追踪</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<ul>
<li><strong>业务需求</strong></li>
</ul>
<p>　　保证一次服务调用，在业务中可以一次追查到本次服务调用涉及的本地服务方法，第三方服务接口。实现日志的链路追踪。保证日志的高查找性。</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>实现步骤</strong></li>
</ul>

<h3>2、整合logback，打印日志，logback.xml (日志配置文件)</h3>
<p>关键代码：[traceId:%X{traceId}]，traceId是通过<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="拦截器" data-pretit="拦截器">拦截器里MDC.put(traceId, tid)添加。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;?</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">?&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configuration </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">debug</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="false"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">日志存储路径</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">property </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="log"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="D:/test/log"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 控制台输出 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appender </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="console"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">encoder </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ch.qos.logback.classic.encoder.PatternLayoutEncoder"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">输出格式化</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pattern</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>[traceId:%X{traceId}]  %d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{50} - %msg%n<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pattern</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">encoder</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appender</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按天生成日志文件 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appender </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="file"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.RollingFileAppender"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rollingPolicy </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.TimeBasedRollingPolicy"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">日志文件名</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FileNamePattern</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>${log}/%d{yyyy-MM-dd}.log<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FileNamePattern</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">保留天数</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MaxHistory</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>30<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MaxHistory</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rollingPolicy</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">encoder </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ch.qos.logback.classic.encoder.PatternLayoutEncoder"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pattern</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>[traceId:%X{traceId}]  %d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{50} - %msg%n<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pattern</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">encoder</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">日志文件最大的大小</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">triggeringPolicy </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.SizeBasedTriggeringPolicy"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MaxFileSize</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>10MB<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MaxFileSize</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">triggeringPolicy</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appender</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
 
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 日志输出级别 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">root </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">level</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="INFO"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appender-ref </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="console"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appender-ref </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="file"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">root</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configuration</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>

<h3>3、application.yml指定logback.xml配置目录</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">logging:
  config: classpath:logback.xml</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>4、异步线程的跟踪ID链路追踪</h3>
<p>业务逻辑是基于线程数据的传递进行处理，主线程传递线程ID到子线程。处理方式：重写线程池的execute（*）、submit（*）方法。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> MyThreadPoolTaskExecutor <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extends</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ThreadPoolTaskExecutor {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyThreadPoolTaskExecutor() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">super</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    }

    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> execute(Runnable task) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">super</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.execute(TraceIdUtil.wrap(task, MDC.getCopyOfContextMap()));
    }


    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> &lt;T&gt; Future&lt;T&gt; submit(Callable&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> task) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">super</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.submit(TraceIdUtil.wrap(task, MDC.getCopyOfContextMap()));
    }

    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Future&lt;?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> submit(Runnable task) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">super</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.submit(TraceIdUtil.wrap(task, MDC.getCopyOfContextMap()));
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>4、异步定时任务线程接口ScheduledExecutorService的日志链路追踪。在执行前，执行后进行跟踪ID的生成和删除。</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> @Bean(name = "scheduledExecutorService"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScheduledExecutorService scheduledExecutorService() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor(corePoolSize,
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BasicThreadFactory.Builder().namingPattern("schedule-pool-%d").daemon(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).build(),
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ThreadPoolExecutor.CallerRunsPolicy()) {
            @Override
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> beforeExecute(Thread thread, Runnable runnable) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">super</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.beforeExecute(thread, runnable);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 为定时任务生成一个 traceId</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                TraceIdUtil.setTraceId();
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可选：添加任务标识</span>
                System.out.println("Scheduled task starting with traceId: " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TraceIdUtil.getTraceId());
            }

            @Override
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> afterExecute(Runnable r, Throwable t) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">super</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.afterExecute(r, t);
                Threads.printException(r, t);
                TraceIdUtil.remove();
            }
        };
    }</span></pre>
</div>
